transform_vectors: transform vectors by left-multiplying an MxM matrix against NxM vectors
normalize_vecs: normalize vector tensors by dividing each vector by its L2 norm
torch_dot: compute the dot product of two tensors along the last dimension
get_ray_limits_box: intersect rays with an NDC bounding box and return min and max entry distances
linspace: create evenly spaced tensors from start to stop replicating numpy.linspace behavior
